title: Boulder Dash
developer: Peter Liepa and Chris Gray (original); First Star Software (Commodore 64 conversion)
build: Re-packaged disk named C64.COM: one program, BOULDER DASH, 16,499 bytes, a BASIC stub and a copier ahead of the game; title screen "(C)1984 First Star Software Inc."

credits.role: design and programming of the original Atari 8-bit game, with its music (Wikipedia)
co-creator; his BASIC game based on The Pit led to it (Wikipedia)
published the Commodore 64 version in 1984; the programmer of the conversion is not named in the sources read

tools.host: Linux 6.18 x86_64, cloud container with no display
tools.widget tests: node: test_levels.js holds the Maps tab builder to a second implementation of the recipe
tools.subagents: one checking agent for the 60-verify sample, claude-opus-5-5

accuracy.note: one checker; 18 wrong in a detail and 2 wrong; the comments sharing a template (cave records, character set and frame table chunks) were corrected too

exclude: zero page: the game's counters, flags and pointers, set at run time
vectors, BASIC's leftovers and the screen of the loader
the cave's map (40 by 22 object codes from $0850), the menu lines and the text screen, built at run time
the character set the VIC reads, copied from $5000-$53FF at start
the current cave's description, copied from the table at $582E when a cave starts
screen buffers, the animated character set and the frame tables copied from $5FE8-$6DFF at start, and sprite data, all built at run time
the 80 by 44 character scroll buffer, redrawn as the cave changes
the game's variables and text buffers
the copy of the screen-copy code from $7EF0 and $7FF0, patched at run time
the program file's copy of the game: the copier at $0828 moves $0870-$4870 to $5000-$8FFF, and the game runs and reads only the moved copy
the KERNAL's table of I/O vectors, set up by the machine and not part of the game

regions: neighbour offsets, scroll row addresses, animation frame tables
cave offsets and the twenty cave descriptions
demonstration script, remap, tile and handler tables
title tune and tile character set
Rockford frames, title map templates, frame blocks
